scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm start -w electron
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w electron
